snippet.title: Shmork Adventures Trailer
snippet.description:
Shmork adventures is a retro-inspired platformer for Gameboy Color! Adventure as Shmork - a shark with legs. Jump, dash, swim and avoid enemies in your adventure through unknown land in search of the ocean!

Link to itch page: https://shmorkgames.itch.io/shmork-adventures
